description: County → Sub-county → Division → Location → Sub-location, the national government administrative units, with 2019 population and land area.
attribution: kenya-locations (https://github.com/DavidAmunga/kenya-locations), with data from the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS), 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, Volume II.

source.title: 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, Volume II: Distribution of Population by Administrative Units

notes: A 2019 snapshot: units created by later gazette notices are missing.
Codes are assigned by this project in KNBS order, two digits per level after the IEBC county code. They are not official KNBS codes.
26 national parks and forests are listed with a population of 0.
Names can repeat within a parent; use codes.
Five names garbled in the scanned source are corrected in scripts/admin/build-knbs.js (NAME_FIXES).
